titles: Shift Garlic & Herb Turkey Proper Pie
method: Use unseasoned mince made from 100% skinless turkey breast, weighed raw. Commercial mixed-cut turkey mince is not the specified ingredient; ask the butcher for breast mince or mince skinless breast at home.

Heat the oven to 200°C fan. Peel and cut the potatoes into even 2cm chunks. Boil for 15–20 minutes until a knife goes through easily, then drain and mash with 2–3 tablespoons of the hot cooking water; no milk or butter is added.
Dice the carrots finely. Stir together the measured light mayonnaise, garlic powder, dried parsley in a small bowl and keep this dressing chilled until serving.

Heat half the measured olive oil in a non-stick frying pan. Add the turkey breast mince, break it into small pieces with a spoon and fry over medium-high heat for about 8–10 minutes. Keep turning until browned and steaming hot throughout; check the centre reaches 75°C for 30 seconds with a clean thermometer. Transfer the cooked filling to a clean plate.

Add the remaining measured olive oil, carrots and 60ml water to the pan. Cover and simmer gently for 8–10 minutes until the carrots soften; add the peas for the final 3 minutes and cook until piping hot. Add a spoonful of water if the pan dries before the carrots are tender.
Return the cooked filling to the vegetables. Keep the chilled dressing separate for serving; spoon the hot filling into a small ovenproof dish.

Spread the mashed potato over the filling and roughen the top with a fork. Bake for 15–20 minutes, until the top colours and the centre of the pie is steaming hot. Rest for 2 minutes. Serve the light mayonnaise, garlic powder, dried parsley dressing alongside.
